name: Listings
headline: Listing audit — 18 listings below CVR benchmark

data.dialNote: Realify will draft every edit and show the before and after. Nothing reaches a listing without your approval.

roles.name: Heroes
roles.why: Traffic is expensive here. A point of CVR is worth more than anywhere else in the catalogue.

roles.name: Core
roles.why: The base of the range. Content completeness matters more than polish.

roles.name: Margin Drivers
roles.why: High CM per unit, so a small CVR gain pays for a lot of studio time.

roles.name: Traffic Drivers
roles.why: Thin CM. Fixes have to be cheap or they do not clear the bar.

roles.name: Supporting
roles.why: No Buy Box target. Realify will not spend studio hours here.

locked.name: Brand voice guide
locked.rule: Sentence case, no exclamation marks, no superlatives without a source. Realify drafts inside the guide and flags anything that needs a human line.

locked.name: Image standards
locked.rule: Seven-shot set, white background on the hero, 2400px minimum, props only in lifestyle frames. Realify can reorder and request shots but never generates imagery.

locked.name: Restricted claims per category
locked.rule: Stoneware may not carry food-safety or oven-temperature claims without the test document on file. Dishwasher-safe requires the current certificate reference.

rules.label: Attribution before edits
rules.def: A Buy Box loss caused by delivery promise does not get fixed with a new title. The waterfall decides the lever.

rules.label: Lift ranges, not point estimates
rules.def: Every fix carries a range and a confidence from prior fixes on comparable listings.

rules.label: One listing, one push
rules.def: Edits batch per listing so the 14-day pre and post read is attributable.

rules.label: Snapshot before publish
rules.def: The current version is saved so a restore is one click, not a rewrite.

agents.name: Merchandiser
agents.role: Owns titles, bullets, images and A+ modules.

agents.name: Pricer
agents.role: Owns any price or offer change the attribution calls for.

agents.name: Keeper
agents.role: Owns backend keywords, category data and compliance checks.
